test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the words in the brackets in the given sentence.

Ten years have passed since my father (is dead).
solution:
The correct answer is '**Died'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence Ten years have passed since my father (is dead), The sentence is in Past tense because the father died 10 years back.
 
• The present perfect is formed using the present tense of the verb " has/have + 1st form of the verb" and the past tense is used to indicate that the action has already happened or completed. The simple past tense says that an action was completed at a time before another action happened in the past or has just happened
 
• In this sentence, it says that 10 years have just passed and the father died 10 years back.

Hence the correct answer is '***Option 2' ***which is '**Died**'.
